    BO13a §2.2.5: all long morphisms have the same domain #

    • Index-generic forms (_at) of the reflecting contours and of Lemma 8.
    • MulBasis.dom_b2, MulBasis.dom_b3: for consecutive long entries σ (s+2) and ρ (s+3+L+1) (resp. σ (s+3+L+1)), every long morphism has the domain of σ (s+2).
